I compared image quality, realism, prompt accuracy, creativity, consistency, speed, ease of use, pricing and overall value before selecting the top three performers.

BLOG SUMMARY

I tested multiple AI tools that claim to be good Midjourney alternatives and selected the best three based on my real-world experience. In this guide, I share the strengths, weaknesses, and real issues I faced while testing each tool. I’ve also included the exact image and animation prompts along with the actual image and video outputs, so you can compare the quality yourself and choose the right AI tool without wasting your time or money.

Prompts Used for Testing

The following prompts were used across every AI tool without any modifications to ensure a fair comparison.

🖼️ Product Image Prompt
Create a premium luxury perfume advertisement poster with a single perfume bottle as the main hero product, positioned in the center and occupying 70% of the frame. The perfume bottle must be fully visible from top to bottom, crystal clear, ultra-sharp, and professionally showcased with no cropping. The bottle design should look expensive, elegant, and modern, made with transparent glass and luxury metallic details. The brand name “IJAZ” must be prominently displayed on the bottle in premium silver typography and also subtly reinforced in the poster branding. Use a sophisticated blue and white luxury color palette, featuring soft white gradients, royal blue highlights, glowing glass reflections, premium light streaks, and subtle luxury particles. The background should feel clean, modern, and high-end with white marble textures, floating blue crystal elements, soft mist effects, and luxury studio lighting. Ensure the perfume bottle remains the absolute focal point with crystal-clear visibility, realistic shadows, sharp reflections, premium packaging details, and high-end commercial advertising aesthetics. The layout should be minimalist and elegant, with plenty of breathing space around the product. No unnecessary objects, no clutter, and no distractions. Add a small premium quote in elegant typography: “Leave a Lasting Impression.” Commercial perfume campaign style, luxury fashion magazine advertisement, photorealistic product photography, ultra-detailed glass textures, realistic lighting, premium branding, award-winning advertising design, luxury fragrance marketing visual, hyper-realistic 8K quality, studio-grade rendering, premium showcase composition.
🎥 Animation Prompt
Ultra-realistic cinematic luxury commercial, camera performs a smooth 180° orbit around the centered perfume bottle with a slow dolly-in while the bottle gracefully floats in mid-air. The bottle gently descends and naturally enters a crystal-clear lake, creating a realistic soft splash with dynamic water ripples and droplets. Camera seamlessly follows the bottle underwater without cuts as volumetric light rays, bubbles, and floating crystal diamonds surround the product. The bottle slowly rotates 15–20° while sinking elegantly with realistic physics, caustic lighting, and premium reflections. End on a perfectly centered underwater hero shot with luxurious blue ambience, ultra-sharp focus, photorealistic 8K quality, smooth cinematic motion, no text, no humans.

Top 3 Midjourney Alternatives with real outputs (Jun 2026)

1. Gemini 

In Gemini, you can generate images, edit images and also create videos. The video quality is good and realistic and images also come out well.

Videos can include audio and the maximum length is up to 10 seconds. It follows prompts properly and even product-related changes work accurately.

From my experience, the output was good in the first attempt itself. I am sharing the result below for reference.

Gemini Generated AI Video

My Experience

The video was generated successfully on the first attempt, with impressive output quality and well-matched sound effects. It followed the prompt accurately and the built-in editing feature was useful. However, image editing wasn’t always consistent, sometimes the edits didn’t apply properly, so I had to retry a few times to get the desired result.

Gemini Pros & Cons

2. GROK

Grok initially offered free image and video generation, but they’ve stopped that now. Instead, they’re offering a 3-day free trial that requires your card details. After the 3-day trial ends, the subscription will automatically activate and the payment will be charged.

The image generation is very fast. It creates 4 images in about 10 seconds and you can choose the one you like best and animate it easily.

If you use the SuperGrok plan, you can generate up to 10 videos per day. You can also extend videos up to 30 seconds, regenerate them if needed and choose between 6-second and 10-second video lengths. It supports 480p and 720p quality and most videos are generated in under a minute.

Note: After generating an image or video, download it immediately. Sometimes the generated files don’t appear in the history. This happened to me and I couldn’t regenerate them because I had already reached the generation limit.

Grok Imagine Generated AI Video

My Experience

Grok generates high-quality images very quickly, making it a strong competitor to Midjourney. Midjourney is also very fast when it comes to image generation.

For video generation, both Grok and Midjourney are fast. However, even with the SuperGrok subscription, there is a daily limit on how many videos you can generate. In comparison, a Midjourney subscription allows you to create more content than Grok, making it a better option if you need to generate a large number of images and videos.

Grok Pros & Cons

3. Reve AI

If you plan to generate a lot of videos and images, Reve’s Pro plan is worth considering. I’ve been using the Pro plan and it has been good for regular use.

You can generate videos by:

  • Uploading an image
  • Entering a text prompt
  • Using one or more reference images

Videos can be generated up to 8 seconds long. You can also add sound, choose resolutions up to 1080p and the available video models include Veo 3.1 and Veo 3.2 Fast. You can also choose the output video size. However, when generating videos using reference images, the portrait mode option is not available.

Reve uses a battery (energy) system. You start with a full battery and the available energy gradually decreases as you generate videos.

Based on my testing, generating an 8-second video without sound consumes around 8 energy. Videos with sound consume twice as much energy, so you’ll reach the monthly limit much faster.

The Pro plan includes 250 video energy per month. If you run out of energy, you can purchase an additional day’s worth of video generation (around 100 seconds of video) for $20.

If you plan to create AI videos regularly, it’s worth considering these limits before subscribing.

Note: Before generating images, set your preferences first. You can choose options such as the number of images to generate, the image aspect ratio and the type of output you want. You can also use Attachments and Custom Instructions to save your preferred settings for more consistent results.

Reve Generated AI Video

My Experience

Reve doesn’t have its own video generation model. It uses Google’s Veo 3.1, which is why the output quality is very good. However, there are a few limitations. For example, when generating videos using reference images, you can’t create them in portrait mode.

Image generation is fast and easy. You can edit generated images directly within Reve, generate up to 8 images at a time and they are usually ready within a minute.

Common Mistakes People Make When Generating AI Images & Videos

Many people blame the AI tool when the real problem is the prompt. Here are the most common mistakes I noticed while testing:

  • Using vague prompts instead of describing the scene clearly.
  • Trying to fit too many ideas into a single prompt.
  • Ignoring camera angles, lighting, and composition.
  • Expecting perfect results on the first try instead of refining the prompt.
  • Not using reference images when the tool supports them.
  • Comparing tools with different prompts instead of using the same prompt for all.
  • Skipping image editing or prompt adjustments after the first generation.
  • Choosing a tool without checking whether it’s better for images, videos, or both.

Frequently Asked Questions


1. What is the best free Midjourney alternative?

If you’re looking for a free option, Google Gemini and Reve AI are excellent choices. Both let you generate high-quality images without paying upfront, while Reve AI also offers strong image editing features.


2. Which AI tool creates images most similar to Midjourney?

Based on my testing, Reve AI came the closest to Midjourney in terms of image quality, prompt accuracy and overall realism. Google Gemini was a close second with impressive consistency.


3. Which AI tool is best for both image and video generation?

Google Gemini is the best all-in-one option because it can generate high-quality images and videos from a single platform. Reve AI is another solid choice if your main focus is creative visuals.


4. Why doesn’t my AI image match my prompt?

In most cases, the problem is the prompt rather than the AI tool. Be specific about the subject, lighting, camera angle, style, and composition. Clear prompts almost always produce better results.


5. Which Midjourney alternative would you recommend in 2026?

If you want an all-round AI tool, choose Google Gemini. If your priority is image quality similar to Midjourney, go with Reve AI. If you also need AI chat and coding features, SuperGrok is the better option.
